profile.name: Calibre
profile.description: Installs Calibre and converts ebooks via chat. Drop a file, name the format you want, and get the converted book back.

memory.content: Always convert ebooks with Calibre's ebook-convert on this computer; never use another converter.
Weekly Calibre update routine scheduled for every Monday at 9:57 AM (user's local time), which updates Calibre and pings the user with the version result.

routines.name: Weekly Calibre update
routines.description: Every Monday morning, update Calibre on the assistant computer and report the version result.
routines.content:
Update Calibre on this computer (the assistant machine) to the latest available package — prefer the system package manager path already in use (e.g. apt upgrade for the calibre package), then confirm ebook-convert still works. Tell the user the result briefly: old vs new version if it changed, or that it was already current. If the update fails, report the error and what they may need to approve or fix.

Fires on:
- cron `57 9 * * 1`

Ask the importing user for:
- Timezone
